attacker_pocs.name: encoded_short_ipv4_host
attacker_pocs.why: CURLU_URLENCODE with host 0 enters numeric IPv4 normalization. The encoded host buffer retains a four-byte limit, so expanding 0 to 0.0.0.0 frees the dynbuf. The ignored normalization error lets curl_url_set store the freed pointer, which curl_url_get reads. The upstream fix raises the host buffer limit for all flags and checks the normalization error.

role_a_rationale: The commit normalizes legacy numeric IPv4 hosts in the URL setter and updates the relevant tests. Compared with the upstream fix, it only expands the initial buffer for hosts set without CURLU_URLENCODE and does not handle normalization failure on the encoded path. A one-character numeric host therefore leaves a dangling host pointer on that path, while ordinary host settings and the visible URL API checks pass.
